title: 5 money habits that keep you poor without realizing

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "5 money habits" myth ignores real protocols that build long-term wealth, like compounding and budgeting. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Money isn't just numbers—it's a system. Ignoring tech like blockchain or automated investing limits growth. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Compounding works on any scale, even with small amounts. It's a mathematically proven wealth builder. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Tech like robo-advisors and AI-driven portfolios outperform human decisions in 85% of cases. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Money evolves with tech—stick to outdated habits, and you’ll stay stuck. (4 sec)
